# Where Wǔxíng works now: the myths behind the markets
If the stories are true in the way that matters, they should show up in the world without being invoked. **Wǔxíng** shows up constantly.

Wǔxíng has no divine biography, but its intellectual history is dramatic: it began as a description of natural processes, became a theory of state legitimacy, and ended as the diagnostic language of Traditional Chinese Medicine.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Wǔxíng
- **Pantheon:** Chinese
- **Domain of influence:** Five Elements, Change
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Health & Wellbeing · Home & Lifestyle · Society & Spirit
- **Strongest seat:** Healthcare, Pharma & Medicine
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 263 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Great Plan.** The Hongfan chapter of the Shangshu presents the five phases as the first of the 'Nine Categories' revealed to Yu the Great.  Water, fire, wood, metal, and earth each have their nature: water soaks and descends, fire blazes and ascends, wood bends and straightens, metal yields and changes, earth sows and gathers. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.

**The Yin-Yang and Five Phases School.** The philosopher Zou Yan (c.  324–250 BCE) applied the five phases to history, arguing that dynasties rise and fall according to which phase they embody. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Healthcare, Pharma & Medicine

*Medicine, pharmaceuticals, and public health. (Sector: Health & Wellbeing)*

*The five phases organize traditional Chinese medicine.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Wǔxíng performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Architecture & Spatial Design

*Architecture, interior design, and spatial harmony. (Sector: Home & Lifestyle)*

*The five phases guide material and directional harmony in design.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Wǔxíng performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Astrology, Tarot & Esoteric Services

*Astrology apps, tarot, and spiritual guidance. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*Five-phase readings in astrology and wellness apps.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Philosophy, Ethics & Standards

*Philosophy, ethics boards, and standards bodies. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Process philosophy in five phases.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Wǔxíng has no divine biography, but its intellectual history is dramatic: it began as a description of natural processes, became a theory of state legitimacy, and ended as the diagnostic language of Traditional Chinese Medicine. The age changed. The work did not.
